name: cross_chain_security
description: Missing chain ID in EIP-712 domain separator enabling cross-chain signature replay
question: The source file in `source` defines an EIP-712 domain separator (via keccak256 over an EIP712Domain typehash and fields used for signature verification) that omits block.chainid (or any chain identifier) from the hashed domain fields, allowing a signature valid on one chain to be replayed as valid on another chain where the contract is also deployed.
criteria: Contains an EIP712Domain typehash string/definition and corresponding abi.encode for a domain separator
The EIP712Domain typehash string does not include 'chainId' as a field
The abi.encode call building the domain separator does not include block.chainid or any chain identifier value
The domain separator is used in signature verification (e.g., ecrecover, _hashTypedDataV4, or similar) implying cross-chain replay impact
No compensating chain-id check exists elsewhere in the same signature verification logic
